svg.title: Thomas and Juliette: read the gains from trade
svg.desc: Thomas reads from the bottom-left and Juliette from the top-right. In Thomas's coordinates omega is (1,9), while the other intersection Z is (9,1). At omega, Juliette's bundle is (9,1); at Z it is (1,9). Both curves have initial utility 3. Inside the green lens both gain; its intersections leave both indifferent. No contract curve is drawn.
